sections.title: The Life of the Mind: Literary Study and the Campus Novel (The One Series)
sections.description: This seminar offers students the opportunity to undertake a semester-long in-depth study of a major literary text from the 20th/21st Century. Discussions will address emergent research methods, advanced writing and critical thinking issues, and debates surrounding canonization. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of current offerings.
